Page templates

Live capture templates are frozen copies of real dubizzle.com.eg pages — they render like production (the % is the pixel difference from the live screenshot). Copy one and build your feature on it, using the design-system components for anything new. Hand-built templates have no capture yet and only approximate the live site. The templates are also a clickable prototype: every link leads to the template it would open on live, desktop and mobile, with the flows stored per section.
